title: Titanfall 2
shortDescription: Respawn's peerless first-person shooter campaign, celebrated for its wall-running parkour fluidity and the bond between Pilot Jack Cooper and Titan BT-7274.
historicalSignificance: Universally revered as one of the greatest single-player FPS campaigns in video game history, featuring the legendary time-shifting level 'Effect and Cause' and introducing movement mechanics that inspired modern shooters and Apex Legends.

editorialContent.overview: Militia rifleman Jack Cooper is thrust into pilot duty on the alien planet Typhon alongside BT-7274, a sentient 24-foot Vanguard-class Titan, to stop the IMC from deploying the catastrophic Fold Weapon.
editorialContent.gameplay: Unrivaled momentum-based movement: seamless wall-running, double-jumping, slide-hopping, and grapple-swinging linked directly to blistering firearm gunplay, contrasting with heavy mech titan loadouts.
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: Pushed a heavily modified Valve Source Engine to deliver blistering 60 FPS across all console versions with dynamic level set-pieces, including automated factory assembly lines and the instantaneous real-time time-travel device in 'Effect and Cause'.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: Achieved legendary status among FPS aficionados for its emotional warmth and relentless mechanical creativity, directly serving as the gameplay foundation for Apex Legends.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved on PS4/Xbox One Blu-ray and PC digital platforms.

awards: Game Critics Awards Best Action Game E3 2016
